The preliminary proposal assumes we finance 90% of eligible invoices with ordinary supplier recourse and no special funding or screening controls. Before I make any binding decision on whether this facility may launch and on what operating terms, I need to conduct our standard round-robin review. I'd like to hear from credit risk, legal, and finance operations in turn. Who would like to start?
